snapshot: WHO Region of the Americas. An insurance-based system run through health-promoting entities (EPS) that is in a deep financial crisis. A new government took office in August 2026.

leadership.role: Minister of Health and Social Protection
leadership.name: Ana María Vesga

agenda.title: Emergency plan for the health system
agenda.text: In September 2026 the president announced an emergency plan (plan de choque) to unblock care: delayed medicines, waiting times for appointments and denied services. November reporting notes progress but close to three million pending cases.

agenda.title: Insurer debts and oversight
agenda.text: Hospital and clinic associations report more than 9 trillion pesos in overdue debt from the five largest debtor insurers. The health superintendency has flagged inconsistencies in payments requested by insurers and is intervening in failing providers.

agenda.title: Wider access to HIV treatment
agenda.text: The ministry has widened access to an HIV medicine and set new obligations for insurers on HIV care.
